i.norm: Verifies that bytes added after an earlier read are stored and returned correctly, exercising the circular (wrap-around) behaviour of the buffer. Scenario on a buffer with capacity 2: 1. Add a first byte, then read it back so the buffer is empty again but its internal read/write offsets have advanced. 2. Add a second byte; the buffer must now report that it holds data. 3. Read that second byte and confirm it matches what was added.
Add and immediately consume the first byte to advance the offsets.
Add a second byte; the buffer should now hold exactly that byte.
Reading it back must return the byte that was just added.
